title: The Responsible teacher of the class
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：responsible　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 responsible 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the musician wrote of ① a responsible teacher of the class in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② more responsible than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the responsible ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most responsible teacher of the class anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1962 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too responsible to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the responsible ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a responsible man for the accident, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as responsible as the man for the accident they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was responsible or not, and he said so.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something responsible, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite responsible; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the responsible ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978, in public, she wrote of another responsible teacher of the class in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more responsible than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most responsible man for the accident in the whole hall, she said in 1980, was the one she could never quite name; the responsible ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 负责（前置定语 a responsible teacher of the class：1968 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件负责的老师）
B. adj. 负责／有责任（比较级 more responsible than：文中两处，一处比负责这个班的老师，一处比预想）
C. adj. 负责／有责任（最高级 the most responsible：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 负责（表语 too responsible to do：母亲觉得它太负责，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有责任（前置定语 a responsible man for the accident：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有责任的人）
F. adj. 有责任（同级比较 as responsible as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对事故负有责任的人相比）
G. adj. 有责任（后置定语 something responsible：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有责任（受程度副词修饰 quite responsible：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a responsible teacher of the class
the most responsible teacher of the class anybody
a responsible man for the accident
The most responsible man for the accident in

answers.why: responsible 意为“负责”，1968 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件负责的老师”，此处作前置定语 a responsible teacher of the class。
responsible 意为“负责”，此处用比较级 more responsible than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
responsible 意为“负责”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最负责的一件，故用最高级 the most responsible teacher of the class。
responsible 意为“负责”，母亲认为这件东西“太负责了，谁也用不上”，too responsible to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
responsible 意为“有责任”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有责任的人”，此处作前置定语 a responsible man for the accident。
responsible 意为“有责任”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对事故负有责任的人一样有责任”，同级比较用 as responsible as。
responsible 意为“有责任”，节目单上那半行字要的是“有责任的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something responsible。
responsible 意为“有责任”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当有责任”，quite 修饰原级 responsible。
responsible 意为“有责任”，1978 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有责任”，故用比较级 more responsible than。
responsible 意为“有责任”，母亲 1980 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最有责任的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most responsible man for the accident。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件负责的老师。（a responsible teacher of the class）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更负责。（more responsible than …）
母亲觉得它太负责，谁也用不上。（too responsible to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有责任的人。（a responsible man for the accident）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对事故负有责任的人一样有责任。（as responsible as …）
到了 1975 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件有责任的东西。（something responsible）
answers: In 1968 the musician wrote of a responsible teacher of the class in the programme.
Everybody said it was more responsible than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too responsible to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a responsible man for the accident.
He said nobody would call it as responsible as the man for the accident they had once had.
By 1975 the programme asked for nothing but something responsible.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 responsible 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the musician wrote of a responsible teacher of the class in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most responsible teacher of the class in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too responsible to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a responsible man for the accident, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite responsible, and everybody laughed.
The responsible ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
